validatorDesign.shape: sec_ or iss_ followed by a 26-character canonical Crockford base32 ULID
validatorDesign.crockford: Alphabet omits I, L, O and U by design; each exclusion is covered by its own rejection case in identity.test.mjs.
validatorDesign.colons: Excluded by the character class, so an instrument scopeId can never swallow a segment under the last-segment-is-slug parser. parseSmartFileEntityId('smartfile:instrument:<node>:extra:doc') returns null.
validatorDesign.extensionPoint: New SCOPE_ID_VALIDATORS table in src/identity.mjs maps scopeType -> rule. jurisdiction keeps the pre-existing FIPS regex; tenant and site are `() => true` beyond non-empty; instrument gets its own named function isInstrumentNodeId. The table, not SMART_FILE_SCOPE_TYPES, is the extension point, per the generalization question in 08_build_scope.
validatorDesign.writableScopes: New WRITABLE_SCOPE_TYPES = ['tenant','instrument']. Names what was already true: jurisdiction and site documents are produced elsewhere and are read-only through this service.
validatorDesign.notReused: Does NOT reuse JURISDICTION_FIPS_RE and does NOT reuse the tenant free-string rule. isInstrumentNodeId('48021') === false and isInstrumentNodeId('acme') === false, both asserted.
